display_name: Lemony Snicket's A Series of Unfortunate Events (Europe) (Fr,Es)

slots_and_copies.name: header
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: Single copy at EEPROM blocks 0-1. Valid iff FUN_08039ac0 sum over 16 bytes == 0 and first 8 bytes match magic (FUN_08039b4c); invalid at boot triggers blank-save recreation in FUN_0803935c. No backup copy exists.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_0
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM blocks 2-21 (addr = 0*0x14+2, count 0x14). Loaded by FUN_080399d0(0); validity flag at manager struct +0x20 = (FUN_08039ac0 sum over 160 bytes == 0) via FUN_08039988(0); consumed by FUN_08039474(0). No generation counter; selection among valid slots is outside the traced code.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_1
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM blocks 22-41 (addr = 1*0x14+2, count 0x14). Loaded by FUN_080399d0(1); validity flag at manager struct +0x24 via FUN_08039988(1); consumed by FUN_08039474(1). No generation counter.

slots_and_copies.name: slot_2
slots_and_copies.selection_rule: EEPROM blocks 42-61 (addr = 2*0x14+2, count 0x14). Loaded by FUN_080399d0(2); validity flag at manager struct +0x28 via FUN_08039988(2); consumed by FUN_08039474(2). No generation counter.

checksums.name: header_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: FUN_08039ac0: sum of u16 words modulo 0x10000 (RAM little-endian words; EEPROM MSB-first serial packing makes each word appear big-endian in the raw .sav file, so file verification sums big-endian word pairs). Writers zero the stored word at header+0x0E, sum all 8 words over 0x00-0x0F, and store (-sum) mod 0x10000. Valid iff the sum over the full 16 bytes including the stored word equals 0.

checksums.name: slot_sum16
checksums.formula_detail: Same FUN_08039ac0 primitive over the full 160-byte (0xA0, 80-word) slot buffer. Validity rule is code-proven: slot is valid iff the total sum equals 0 (FUN_08039988). The stored word position is inferred as the last word of the slot (slot+0x9E) by analogy with the header; no slot-checksum writer exists in the corpus, so the position is unproven. Both corpus samples are blank slots (8x0x00 + 152x0xFF) summing to 0xffb4 != 0, i.e. invalid/empty, as expected.

io_driver_functions.notes: DMA3 primitive: programs DMA source/dest/control (count|0x80000000 enable), busy-waits on busy bit; one endpoint is EEPROM window 0x0D000000. Used for both directions.
EEPROM read one 8-byte block: MSB-first address bitstream via FUN_080510f4 to 0x0D000000 (cmd len addr-bits+3, data len 0x44), packs received bits MSB-first into 4 u16 words.
EEPROM write one 8-byte block: serializes 4 u16 words + address MSB-first (len addr-bits+0x43) via DMA to 0x0D000000, then polls EEPROM busy (0x0D000000 & 1) with timeout.
Write wrapper: calls FUN_08051238(addr, ptr, 1) with wait-for-completion enabled.
Write-verify: reads block back via FUN_08051174 and compares all 4 u16 words; returns 0 on match, 0x8000 on mismatch.
Not an erase: EEPROM bus timing/WAITCNT profile select (modes 4 / 0x40 / other). No EEPROM erase operation exists; blank state is the erased 0xFF state plus explicit zero-prefix writes.
Sum16 primitive: sum of byte_count/2 u16 words modulo 0x10000. Callers negate when storing; validation requires total sum == 0.
Block reader: reads block_count consecutive 8-byte blocks (ram_ptr += 8, addr += 1), up to 3 attempts per block, framed by FUN_08039cb8/FUN_08039d04 session begin/end.
Block writer with verify: per block FUN_08051224 write + FUN_08051398 read-back compare, up to 3 attempts per block, same session framing.
Blank-header creation: memcpy 16-byte ROM template to RAM header, store negated FUN_08039ac0 sum at +0x0E, flush blocks 0-1 via FUN_08039c30.

Header re-checksum and flush: reads blocks 0-1, zeroes RAM header +0x0E, stores negated sum, writes header back if first u32 (magic dword) unchanged. Caller not in corpus (unrecovered jumptable suspected). Only path persisting header bytes 0x08-0x0D mutations.
Slot loader: zeroes 160-byte buffer (FUN_080393fc), reads 20 blocks from EEPROM addr slot*0x14+2 via FUN_08039bb4.
Slot validator: stores boolean (FUN_08039ac0 slot sum over 0xA0 bytes == 0) at manager struct +0x20+slot*4.
Header validator: returns 1 iff EEPROM read ok AND 16-byte sum == 0 AND first 8 bytes match the expected magic constant.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Boot-time save load: validate EEPROM header (magic + sum16) before loading slots. FUN_0803935c itself has no traced caller (top-level, unrecovered jumptable suspected).
caller_chains.how_mapped: Explicit func_0x08039b4c call site in FUN_0803935c body in ghidra/decompiled.c; FUN_08039bb4/FUN_08051174/FUN_080510f4 chain confirmed in bodies and ghidra/callgraph.json.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Blank-save creation when header validation fails at boot: copy ROM header template, fix checksum at +0x0E, write+verify blocks 0-1 (verify leg: FUN_08039c30 -> 0x08051398 -> 0x08051174). Followed by zeroing the slot buffer (FUN_080393fc) and writing an 8-byte zero prefix to each slot start via FUN_08039c30 with count=1 at blocks 2, 22, 42.
ram_fields_updated: slot buffer +0x00..0x9F (zeroed; only +0x00..0x07 flushed per slot)
caller_chains.how_mapped: Explicit call sites in FUN_0803935c and FUN_08039afc bodies in ghidra/decompiled.c; slot-prefix geometry (count=1, addrs 2/22/42 step 0x14) read directly from the FUN_0803935c loop and cross-verified against the 8x0x00+152x0xFF pattern in both .sav files.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Load all three slots into the 160-byte RAM buffer after header validation (or blank creation), validate each with FUN_08039988 -> FUN_08039ac0, then build per-slot state with FUN_08039474.
caller_chains.how_mapped: Explicit call sites in FUN_0803935c, FUN_0803994c, FUN_080399d0, FUN_08039988 bodies; slot EEPROM address formula slot*0x14+2 with count 0x14 read from FUN_080399d0.

caller_chains.trigger_context: Header update flush: re-read header, recompute checksum, write back if magic dword unchanged. Triggering gameplay event and the mutator of header bytes 0x08/0x0C are outside the corpus (no traced caller).
caller_chains.how_mapped: Function body in ghidra/decompiled.c; caller search over all 273 bodies and ghidra/callgraph.json found no caller.

fields.name: header_magic
fields.update_mechanism: Copied from ROM template at blank-header creation (FUN_08039afc via FUN_0800c2bc); validated byte-by-byte at boot (FUN_08039b4c) and as first u32 before header reflush (FUN_08039a48). RAM mirror is header struct +0x00; absolute RAM address unresolved in corpus.
fields.evidence: Bytes 37 35 30 30 45 55 53 41 at offset 0 in both .sav files; 8-byte compare loop in FUN_08039b4c body.

fields.name: header_byte_08
fields.update_mechanism: Mutated in RAM by code outside the corpus, then persisted with a refreshed checksum by FUN_08039a48 (flush only; the mutator itself was not found). Covered by the header sum16, so any change requires checksum repair. Flag-like 0x00/0xFF pattern; semantics unknown.
fields.evidence: Only differing byte besides 0x0C between the two captures (saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt); PACKET probe confirms single-byte mutation at 0x08 triggers blank-save rewrite (integrity coverage).

fields.name: header_byte_09
fields.update_mechanism: Persisted by FUN_08039a48 flush; covered by header sum16. Constant 0x85 in both blank captures; may pair with byte 0x08 as a u16. No individual reader in corpus.
fields.evidence: Constant byte in both .sav files; no dedicated accessor in ghidra/decompiled.c.

fields.name: header_word_0a
fields.update_mechanism: Covered by header sum16 only; no individual writer/reader traced. Endianness unproven (zero in all samples).
fields.evidence: Zero bytes at 0x0A-0x0B in both .sav files; no accessor found in the 273-function corpus.

fields.name: header_counter_candidate
fields.update_mechanism: Incremented between the two captures (file bytes 00 00 -> 01 00, little-endian reading) by a mutator outside the corpus and persisted by FUN_08039a48 with checksum refresh. Counter semantics are an inference from the +1 delta; big-endian reading (0x0000 -> 0x0100) cannot be excluded.
fields.evidence: Byte diff at 0x0C (00 -> 01) in saves/hexdump_and_diffs.txt; checksum remained valid only via the compensating +0xFF00 big-endian delta at 0x08 (net +0x10000 mod 0x10000), consistent with a FUN_08039a48 reflush.

fields.name: header_checksum
fields.update_mechanism: Zeroed, then set to (-sum of all 8 u16 words over header 0x00-0x0F) mod 0x10000 by FUN_08039afc/FUN_08039a48 using FUN_08039ac0. RAM word is little-endian; raw file bytes are FF 80 (high byte first) due to MSB-first EEPROM packing. Validation: full-region sum == 0.
fields.evidence: Python verification: stored 0xff80 == computed negated sum 0xff80 and total big-endian word sum 0x0000 in both .sav files; formula read from FUN_08039ac0/FUN_08039a48/FUN_08039afc bodies.

fields.name: slot0_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Blank-init writes the first 8 bytes of the zeroed 160-byte slot buffer to EEPROM block 2 (FUN_0803935c via FUN_08039c30 count=1). Read back as part of the 20-block slot load (FUN_080399d0).
fields.evidence: 8x0x00 at 0x10-0x17 in both files matches the count=1 prefix write at block 2 in FUN_0803935c; remainder of slot is erased 0xFF.

fields.name: slot0_payload
fields.update_mechanism: Part of the 160-byte slot (EEPROM blocks 3-21) loaded by FUN_080399d0(0) and summed by FUN_08039988(0). No populated sample and no payload writer in corpus; internal field layout unknown.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both blank captures; slot geometry from FUN_080399d0 address/count formula only.

fields.name: slot1_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Blank-init writes first 8 bytes of zeroed slot buffer to EEPROM block 22 (FUN_0803935c via FUN_08039c30 count=1).
fields.evidence: 8x0x00 at 0xB0-0xB7 in both files matches prefix write at block 22 (1*0x14+2) in FUN_0803935c.

fields.name: slot1_payload
fields.update_mechanism: Part of the 160-byte slot (EEPROM blocks 23-41). No populated sample; layout unknown.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both blank captures; geometry from FUN_080399d0 formula only.

fields.name: slot2_prefix
fields.update_mechanism: Blank-init writes first 8 bytes of zeroed slot buffer to EEPROM block 42 (FUN_0803935c via FUN_08039c30 count=1).
fields.evidence: 8x0x00 at 0x150-0x157 in both files matches prefix write at block 42 (2*0x14+2) in FUN_0803935c.

fields.name: slot2_payload
fields.update_mechanism: Part of the 160-byte slot (EEPROM blocks 43-61). No populated sample; layout unknown.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both blank captures; geometry from FUN_080399d0 formula only.

fields.name: slot_checksum_candidate_slot0
fields.update_mechanism: Inferred stored word (slot+0x9E, last word of the checksummed region) by analogy with header_checksum. Validity rule (full-slot FUN_08039ac0 sum == 0) is code-proven in FUN_08039988; stored position has no writer in corpus to confirm it. Blank slots sum to 0xffb4 (invalid). Same candidate applies at file offsets 334 (slot1) and 494 (slot2).
fields.evidence: FUN_08039988 body proves the sum-over-0xA0==0 rule; position inferred from header layout only. No valid slot sample exists.

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.update_mechanism: EEPROM blocks 62-63 inside the 512-byte image but outside every traced read/write range; never accessed by traced code.
fields.evidence: All 0xFF in both files; max EEPROM block touched by traced code is 61 (slot 2 end).

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Flip one bit with no checksum repair (control)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Header sum != 0, FUN_08039b4c fails, FUN_0803935c recreates blank header and slot prefixes; boot as no-save. Already probe-confirmed per PACKET.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change magic byte 0x37 -> 0x38, then repair header checksum (recompute negated big-endian sum16, store at 0x0E)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Checksum passes but 8-byte magic compare in FUN_08039b4c fails; blank-save rewrite, distinguishing magic check from checksum check.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set LE u16 to 0x0002 / 0x0010 / 0xFFFF in separate runs, repairing header checksum each time
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If a benign counter: normal boot and the value is preserved or incremented by the next FUN_08039a48 flush (check post-boot .sav dump). Blank rewrite refutes benign-counter hypothesis.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Set to 0x01 / 0x7F / 0x80 in separate runs, repairing header checksum each time
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If a pure flag/counter byte: normal boot in all cases. Any blank rewrite or changed title/language UI indicates a validated selector value.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Forge slot 0 validity: write 0x01 at 0x10, zero the word at 0xAE, set it to the negated big-endian sum16 over slot bytes 0x10-0xAF
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If stored-word position (+0x9E) is correct: FUN_08039988(0) marks slot 0 valid and file-select shows it loadable. Still-empty display refutes the position; repeat with stored word at slot+0x00 and slot+0x08.
No behavioral change and bytes survive a boot/save cycle, confirming the tail is never accessed. Rewritten bytes would prove an untraced accessor exists.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Zero all slot bytes while keeping a valid repaired header
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: All-zero slot buffers sum to 0, so FUN_08039988 marks all three slots valid with zeroed payloads: three loadable blank games on file-select would confirm the sum-only slot validity rule with no secondary in-slot magic.

open_questions: What are the semantics of header bytes 0x08, 0x09 (constant 0x85), 0x0A-0x0B, and 0x0C-0x0D (counter candidate)? Which code mutates them in RAM before the FUN_08039a48 flush? No mutator or caller of FUN_08039a48 exists in the 273-function corpus.
What is the internal field layout of a populated 160-byte slot? Both corpus saves are blank-initialized (8x0x00 + 152x0xFF per slot); a real in-game save capture is required.
Which function writes a full populated slot (20 blocks via FUN_08039c30 with count 0x14) and computes the slot checksum? Only count=1 prefix writes and header writes were traced.
Where exactly is the slot checksum stored word (hypothesized slot+0x9E)? The FUN_08039988 sum==0 validity rule is proven, the position is not.
What are the absolute RAM mirror addresses (0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx) of the header struct and manager struct? All _DAT_ literal-pool values are unresolved in the corpus, so ram_addr is null throughout.

How does the game choose among multiple valid slots (file-select presentation / most-recent logic)? FUN_08039474 builds per-slot state but no recency/generation comparison was found; no generation counter exists in the traced code.

What are the EEPROM config values (block-count limit at cfg+4, address-width at cfg+8) in ROM data? 64 blocks / 512 bytes is verified from the image; the config words themselves are not in the corpus.

Does the ROM header template used by FUN_08039afc hold 0x0000 at +0x0E (required for its non-zeroing checksum fix-up to produce a valid header)? The template bytes are not in the corpus; both real blank headers validate, which supports but does not prove it.
